headline: Strong US-led beat; FY27 guidance raised

highlights: Business performance: Consolidated revenue grew 36.3% YoY to Rs26bn, with broad-based growth across the business.
The US business grew 65.4% YoY to US$106mn on strong base-portfolio volumes (up 23% ex-new launches) and new launches, including Bosutinib, which is still under exclusivity.
Human health returned to double-digit growth on better field force productivity and chronic and specialty traction, and animal health grew 23%.
API revenue was volume-led and rose 38.9% YoY to Rs4.4bn, backed by a broad customer and product base and some CMO deliveries to key customers.
valuation: Management aspires to ~20% EBITDA margins by FY28-29E, offering upside to our estimates.
Valuation: We maintain BUY with a revised target price of Rs1,119 (earlier: Rs959), rolling forward our valuation to Sep-28E and applying 21x Sep-28E EPS.
Our valuation factors in improving India business momentum, sustained US generics growth, a healthy complex generics pipeline, and gradual operating leverage.
watch: API revenue was volume-led and rose 38.9% YoY to Rs4.4bn, backed by a broad customer and product base and some CMO deliveries to key customers.
Outlook: We estimate revenue to grow from Rs94.2bn in FY27 to Rs112.8bn in FY29 (~9.4% CAGR), driven by US generics launches, improving India branded performance, and sustained API and Ex-US growth.
